content.comment_body: Hello! I created a small test program using [product_name] and developed a visualization. Both the program and visualization were downloaded to [product_name] without errors. However, when accessing the visualization in a browser like Chrome, only the text appears; backgrounds and buttons are missing, so none of the interactive elements work. The end of the menu is also absent. I checked the browser settings and enabled images, Flash, and JavaScript for the site, but this did not resolve the issue. Displaying pages directly from the project folder on my computer works perfectly. While inspecting with F12, numerous errors show up, and the errors change each time the visualization is started, suggesting some random alterations to JavaScript. What might be causing this issue? Expected output: [snip]. What I see: [snip]. What happens after restarting the visualization: [snip].

Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. Could you upload your [document] project and [product_name] program as a zip file? Also, please specify which [product_name] model you have by providing the [article_no], and mention your [product_name] Web Editor version number.
I have attached my projects. My device is [product_name] [article_no], firmware version [version_no]. The [product_name] Web Editor version is [version_no].
I tested your project with four browsers, and it functioned correctly in all cases: Internet Explorer 11, Firefox, Google Chrome, and Opera.
I rechecked this on Google Chrome, Firefox, and Microsoft Edge, and the result was the same across all browsers. Could the issue be related to [product_name] or its firmware?

That's a challenging question. I am using a first-generation [product_name] with upgraded firmware ([version_no]). My [product_name] Web Editor version matches yours at [version_no], and my operating system is Windows 7. You may want to initiate a Support Request.
I have attached my test projects. Please give them a try.
You could try uninstalling [product_name] Web Editor and reinstalling it. Alternatively, try installing it on a different PC to help determine if the issue is with the PC or [product_name] module.
I followed all your instructions, but the problem persists. I tested on another computer running Windows 7 as well.
I tried your example, but it also does not function correctly. I have contacted [company_name] Support and am waiting for their response.

Hello again! I resolved the issue by replacing the SD card in [product_name] with a higher-class card, and now everything works, including your example. The previous card was on the left in the photo, the new one on the right. I reviewed the [product_name] manual but did not find specific SD card requirements. This was a challenging but ultimately successful fix.

Hello [user_name], glad to hear it's working now. Thanks for your feedback; your solution may assist others facing similar issues. I've used various types of microSD cards, including SD, SDHC, and SDXC formatted with FAT32 (without the quick format option). For SDXC (64GB), I created a 32GB partition and used cards from different manufacturers, but never encountered any issues.

analysis.insight_summary: The user encountered problems with images and interactive features not displaying within their [product_name] Web Editor visualization in multiple browsers and computers, resulting in a non-functional interface. Other users tested the same project across various environments without issue, pointing to a problem related to firmware, SD card quality, or other hardware-specific factors. Ultimately, the issue was resolved by switching to a higher-quality SD card.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects all graphical and interactive elements created in [product_name] Web Editor to display and operate properly within standard web browsers, matching the visualization's design intent.
